_notes: This file is the immutable contract between one bootstrapper build and one runtime payload.
which fills sha256 and size_bytes from the payload it actually produced. Never hand-edit those.
There is deliberately no 'latest' here and no fall-forward: a bootstrapper installs the exact
version named above or it installs nothing at all.
The asset_url points at the release tag that will carry this payload. Until that RC release is
published the URL 404s, which the bootstrapper reports as a readable download failure -- it
never falls back to another version or another host.
The all-zero sha256 above is the unpublished-RC placeholder: no real payload can match it, so a
bootstrapper built against it refuses every download rather than installing something unverified.
